trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy.

2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent production release with a healthy status (the v2.3.1-rc was healthy but only in staging, so it wasn't eligible). Executed a rollback to **v2.3.0** across all regions — the rollout completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call engineer paged) describing the health check failures in v2.3.1 and the rollback action taken.

Recommendation before closing the incident: verify health checks pass on v2.3.0 and investigate the v2.3.1 changes to find the root cause of the regression before any redeployment.
